display.summary: Reports fixes, with a command that counts records saved before activity logging; stored-file access for prefixed mounts and public documents; pages that load only the active theme.
highlights: Reports: the user report opens on every period the page offers, including quarter, half-year, year and a custom range.
Reports: each model has one entry with one translated label, and the search field suggests users, models and operations.
Reports: tall tables scroll inside their cards. python manage.py dlux_backfill_report_activity counts records saved before activity logging.
Stored files: a project that mounts DjangoLux under a prefix now passes the proxy's access check.
register_document_file(public=...) serves published documents to signed-out visitors; DLUX_PUBLIC_MEDIA and DLUX_APP_ONLY_MEDIA accept file patterns.
Pages link only the active theme's stylesheet; switching themes loads the new one before fading to it.
From 1.15.2 or earlier? This includes the 1.15.3 security fix: afterwards run ./start.sh check --fix (Composer 1.9.2+) so stored files stay private.
